player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Igikorwa cyo kwimura kigomba kuba muburyo [macro micro] hamwe nimero 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Buri cyuho kigomba kuba kiri hagati ya 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, umurongo cyangwa ikorosi biri hanze y'intera.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Umukinnyi agomba gukina ku mbuga ikurikiraho.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} yakinnye kuri micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Player {opponent_id} azakina kuri {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Umukinnyi {player_id} atsinda umukino wa Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
outcome.draw: Umukino warangiye ari ubusa ku busa!
